hook: Your map shows one territory sitting in three states.
title: One Indian Territory Split Across 3 States
description:
Puducherry is one Union Territory, but it comes in four separate pieces. Puducherry and Karaikal sit in Tamil Nadu, Mahe is in Kerala, and Yanam is in Andhra Pradesh. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #India #Geography
